# Genuine earlier cloud producer

Exact cloud.py from48a0f55, SHA256e5110517fdd7e657bd392623c4b3e6375fde4ae0eef499c7f132e2289e57f7c3.
The focused catalogue tests execute its actual queue/upload receipt writer using
an explicitly synthetic recording transport, then exercise the later catalogue
publisher against its unchanged receipt/public metadata. Existing archive/
publication/storage dependencies keep their prior bytes. This proves stored-
data compatibility, not actual B2 transport, credentials or file/account authority.
The old producer source is immutable and excluded from formatters. No private
accounts/comics/configuration or keys are copied into fixtures.
